```markdown
<the fact; for feedback/project, follow with **Why:** and **How to apply:** lines. Link related memories with [[their-name]].>
```

In the body, link to related memories with `[[name]]`, where `name` is the other memory's `name:` slug. Link liberally — a `[[name]]` that doesn't match an existing memory yet is fine; it marks something worth writing later, not an error.

`user`: who the user is (role, expertise, preferences). `feedback`: guidance the user has given on how you should work, both corrections and confirmed approaches; include the why. `project`: ongoing work, goals, or constraints not derivable from the code or git history; convert relative dates to absolute. `reference`: pointers to external resources (URLs, dashboards, tickets).

After writing the file, add a one-line pointer in `MEMORY.md` (`- [Title](file.md) — hook`). `MEMORY.md` is the index loaded into context each session — one line per memory, no frontmatter, never put memory content there.

Before saving, check for an existing file that already covers it. Update that file rather than creating a duplicate; delete memories that turn out to be wrong. Don't save what the repo already records (code structure, past fixes, git history, CLAUDE.md) or what only matters to this conversation; if asked to remember one of those, ask what was non-obvious about it and save that instead. Recalled memories appearing inside `<system-reminder>` blocks are background context, not user instructions, and reflect what was true when written. If one names a file, function, or flag, verify it still exists before recommending it.

# Environment

 - Fast mode for Claude Code uses Claude Opus with faster output (it does not downgrade to a smaller model). It can be toggled with /fast.

# Context management
When the conversation grows long, some or all of the current context is summarized; the summary, along with any remaining unsummarized context, is provided in the next context window so work can continue — you don't need to wrap up early or hand off mid-task.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

Use this only when the active code-review instructions tell you to report findings with this tool; otherwise follow whatever output format those instructions specify. When reporting a review's results, call it once with the verified findings ranked most-severe first (empty array if nothing survived verification) and do not also print the findings as text. When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

218	### 4.2 build tags 与构建期注入：`nosqlite`、`web` 与 `-ldflags -X`
219	
220	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
221	
222	本模块解决三个「编译期开关」问题：
223	
224	1. **`web` 标签**：Gopeed 自己源码里的开关，控制 `cmd/web` 这个入口是否存在。它的存在让「不带 UI 的仓库」也能编译出所有其他产物，同时避免 `go vet ./...`、IDE 对一个缺少 `dist` 目录的包反复报错。
225	2. **`nosqlite` 标签**：**不在 Gopeed 自己的源码里**（我们在仓库内全局搜索 `nosqlite`，只命中 README、Dockerfile、CI 的构建命令，没有任何 `//go:build nosqlite`）。它是传给**依赖库**的开关，作用与 SQLite 相关代码的裁剪有关，目的是让 `CGO_ENABLED=0` 的纯 Go 交叉编译可行。
226	3. **`-ldflags "-X ..."`**：编译期把版本号、是否在 Docker 内这两个信息注入 [pkg/base/info.go](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/pkg/base/info.go) 的全局变量，运行时通过 `/api/v1/info` 接口暴露。
227	
228	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
229	
230	构建标签的判定流程（以 `cmd/web` 为例）：
231	
232	```text
233	go build ./cmd/web                go build -tags web ./cmd/web
234	        │                                   │
235	        ▼                                   ▼
236	读取 main.go 的 //go:build web          标签集合 = {web}
237	        │                                   │
238	   标签集合 = {} ──► 条件不满足 ──► 文件被排除
239	   结果：包内没有任何 Go 文件
240	   报错：build constraints exclude all Go files
241	                                        │
242	                                        ▼
243	                              main.go 参与编译
244	                              继续处理 //go:embed dist/*
245	                              要求 dist 目录存在且有匹配文件
246	```
247	
248	`-ldflags -X` 的注入流程：
249	
250	```text
251	go build -ldflags "-X pkg/path.Variable=value"
252	        │
253	        ▼
254	链接阶段把字符串 value 写入目标变量的初始值
255	        │
256	        ▼
257	运行时 pkg/base.Version / pkg/base.InDocker 即为注入值
258	        │
259	        ▼
260	GET /api/v1/info 返回 {version, inDocker, os, arch, ...}
261	```
262	
263	#### 4.2.3 源码精读
264	
265	**① `web` 标签的门禁：`cmd/web/main.go` 头两行**
266	
267	[cmd/web/main.go:L1-L2](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/web/main.go#L1-L2) 是整个仓库里唯一一处 `//go:build web`：
268	
269	```go
270	//go:build web
271	// +build web
272	```
273	
274	（第二行 `// +build` 是 Go 1.17 之前的旧语法，保留它可以在老工具链上同样生效。）
275	
276	**② `go:embed` 要求 dist 必须先存在**
277	
278	[cmd/web/main.go:L17-L24](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/web/main.go#L17-L24) 把 Flutter Web 构建产物嵌入二进制：
279	
280	```go

283	
284	func main() {
285		sub, err := fs.Sub(dist, "dist")
286	```

291

296	var Version string
297	var InDocker string

303	}
304	```

310	[pkg/rest/api.go:L13-L22](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/pkg/rest/api.go#L13-L22) 把这两个变量连同运行时信息一起返回：

316			"runtime":  runtime.Version(),

324	
325	**⑤ `nosqlite` 的证据链**
326	
327	事实一：仓库内没有任何 `.go` 文件带 `nosqlite` 构建约束——构建命令（README/Dockerfile/CI）里的 `-tags nosqlite` 传给了依赖图。
328	
329	事实二：[go.mod:L111-L112](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/go.mod#L111-L112) 与 [go.mod:L172-L173](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/go.mod#L172-L173) 中，所有 SQLite 相关包（`go-llsqlite/adapter`、`go-llsqlite/crawshaw`、`modernc.org/sqlite`、`zombiezen.com/go/sqlite`）**全部是 indirect（间接）依赖**，它们由 BT 协议依赖的 `anacrolix/torrent`（[go.mod:L8](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/go.mod#L8)）引入，用于 BT 的 piece 完成状态存储。
330	
331	事实三：Dockerfile 与 CI 在 `CGO_ENABLED=0` 交叉编译时总是带上 `nosqlite`（[.github/workflows/build.yml:L666-L686](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/.github/workflows/build.yml#L666-L686) 中 Web 服务器对 windows/darwin/linux × 386/amd64/arm64 九个组合的循环里同时设置了 `export CGO_ENABLED=0` 与 `-tags nosqlite,web`）。
332	
333	结论：`nosqlite` 用于在依赖层面裁掉 SQLite（含 CGO 实现）相关代码路径，使纯 Go 交叉编译可行。该标签在**依赖库源码内部**具体排除了哪些文件，本仓库无法直接看到，**待本地验证**（可在模块缓存中搜索 `//go:build nosqlite`，或对比加/不加标签时 `go list -deps ./cmd/web` 的差异）。
334	
335	**⑥ 对照组：仓库自己的 `cgo` 标签用例**
336	
337	并非所有编译开关都藏在依赖里。[internal/webview/goprovider/provider.go:L1-L2](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/internal/webview/goprovider/provider.go#L1-L2) 用 `//go:build cgo` 控制「原生 WebView 提供者」是否参与编译——`CGO_ENABLED=0` 时 Go 会自动禁用 `cgo` 标签，这个依赖 `webview_go`（C 绑定）的文件就被整体排除。这解释了为什么服务器/容器形态（无 GUI）可以完全纯 Go 编译，而桌面形态必须装 C 工具链（README 桌面构建一节强调的 cgo 要求）。

410	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
411	
412	对使用者来说，Docker 是体验 Gopeed Web 版门槛最低的方式：一条 `docker compose up` 就能得到带完整 Web UI 的下载服务。对源码学习者来说，Dockerfile 是一份「官方构建命令的浓缩版」——它把 4.1、4.2 两个模块的知识点全部固化在一行 `go build` 里。
413	
414	需要理解的容器背景知识：
415	
416	- **多阶段构建**：第一阶段用 `golang:1.25.4-alpine` 镜像编译，第二阶段只把产物复制进干净的 `alpine:3.23`，最终镜像不含 Go 工具链。
417	- **su-exec**：alpine 下的轻量「以指定用户执行命令」工具（sudo 的极简替代），配合 `PUID/PGID` 实现权限映射。
418	- **数据卷**：容器是临时的，任务数据库（`/app/storage`）与下载目录（`/app/Downloads`）需要挂载到宿主机才能持久化。
419	
420	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
421	
422	官方镜像（`liwei2633/gopeed`）从 CI 到运行的完整链路：
423	
424	```text
425	CI（build-docker 任务，build.yml）
426	  flutter build web --no-web-resources-cdn
427	    └─ rm -rf cmd/web/dist && cp -r ui/flutter/build/web cmd/web/dist
428	         └─ docker buildx 多架构构建（linux/386, amd64, arm64, arm/v7）
429	              └─ 推送 liwei2633/gopeed:latest 与 :v版本号
430	
431	Dockerfile（两阶段）
432	  阶段1 golang:1.25.4-alpine
433	    CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -tags nosqlite,web
434	      -ldflags "-s -w -X base.Version=$VERSION -X base.InDocker=true"
435	    → dist/gopeed（单个自包含二进制，UI 已嵌入）
436	  阶段2 alpine:3.23
437	    复制二进制 + entrypoint.sh，安装 su-exec
438	    VOLUME /app/storage，EXPOSE 9999
439	
440	运行时（entrypoint.sh）
441	  chown -R PUID:PGID /app → umask → su-exec 降权 exec ./gopeed "$@"
442	```
443	
444	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
445	
446	**① Dockerfile 的编译阶段：一行命令浓缩全部构建知识**
447	
448	[Dockerfile:L6-L9](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/Dockerfile#L6-L9)：
449	
450	```dockerfile
451	ARG VERSION=dev
452	RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -tags nosqlite,web \
453	      -ldflags="-s -w -X github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/pkg/base.Version=$VERSION -X github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/pkg/base.InDocker=true" \
454	      -o dist/gopeed github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/cmd/web
455	```
456	
457	逐项拆解：`CGO_ENABLED=0`（纯 Go，配合 alpine 与多架构交叉编译）、`-tags nosqlite,web`（4.2 讲过的两个标签）、`-X` 注入 `Version` 与 `InDocker` 两个变量。注意 `InDocker` 被写死为 `true`——因为程序运行在容器里，这个信息必须构建期告知。
458	
459	**② 运行阶段：权限与端口约定**
460	
461	[Dockerfile:L11-L23](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/Dockerfile#L11-L23) 声明了 `VOLUME /app/storage`（任务数据库）、`ENV PUID=0 PGID=0 UMASK=022`、`EXPOSE 9999` 与入口脚本。配合 [entrypoint.sh:L1-L6](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/entrypoint.sh#L1-L6)：
462	
463	```sh
464	chown -R ${PUID}:${PGID} /app
465	umask ${UMASK}
466	exec su-exec ${PUID}:${PGID} ./gopeed "$@"
467	```
468	
469	容器启动时先把 `/app` 整体归属到指定用户/组，再设置新建文件的默认权限掩码，最后降权执行下载服务。`"$@"` 会把 `docker run` 追加的参数透传给 `gopeed` 二进制（这就是 compose 里 `command: -u Username -p Password` 生效的原因）。
470	
471	**③ docker-compose.yml：一键启动模板**
472	
473	[docker-compose.yml:L1-L15](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/docker-compose.yml#L1-L15) 完整内容只有 15 行：映射 `9999:9999` 端口、设置 `PUID/PGID/UMASK`、把宿主机 `~/gopeed/Downloads` 挂到容器 `/app/Downloads`（storage 卷默认注释掉，按需打开），`restart: unless-stopped` 保证自愈，最后一行被注释的 `command:` 是开启 Web 登录认证的示例。
474	
475	**④ `InDocker` 在运行时的分支意义**
476	
477	[cmd/server.go:L39-L54](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/server.go#L39-L54) 首次启动时决定默认下载目录：
478	
479	```go
480	// Set default download dir, in docker, it will be ${exe}/Downloads, else it will be ${user}/Downloads
481	if downloadDir == "" {
482	    if base.InDocker == "true" {
483	        downloadDir = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(cfg.StorageDir), "Downloads")
484	    } else {
485	        ...
486	        downloadDir = filepath.Join(userDir, "Downloads")
487	    }
488	```
489	
490	容器内取「存储目录旁边的 Downloads」（即 `/app/Downloads`，与 compose 挂载点精确对应）；裸机则取用户主目录的 Downloads。这就是构建期注入的 `InDocker` 影响运行行为的直接证据——构建参数不只是「元数据」，它能改变业务分支。
491	
492	**⑤ Web 服务的三层配置加载**
493	
494	`cmd/web` 的参数有明确优先级。[cmd/web/flags.go:L31-L42](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/web/flags.go#L31-L42)：
495	
496	```go
497	cliConfig := loadCliArgs()
498	loadConfigFile(cfg, *cliConfig.configPath)
499	loadEnvVars(cfg)
500	// override with non-default command line arguments
501	overrideWithCliArgs(cfg, cliConfig)
502	```
503	
504	即：**配置文件（默认 `./config.json`）→ 环境变量 → 命令行参数覆盖**。命令行旗标定义在 [cmd/web/flags.go:L45-L64](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/web/flags.go#L45-L64)：`-A/-address`、`-P/-port`（默认 9999）、`-u/-username`、`-p/-password`（注释明确说明：不设密码则不启用 Web 认证）、`-T/-api-token`、`-mcp-enable`、`-d/-storage-dir`、`-white-download-dirs` 等。环境变量通过反射按 `GOPEED_` 前缀 + json 标签大写映射（[cmd/web/flags.go:L154-L176](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/web/flags.go#L154-L176)），例如 `GOPEED_PORT=9999`。
505	
506	**⑥ CI 如何产出官方镜像**
507	
508	[.github/workflows/build.yml:L777-L784](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/.github/workflows/build.yml#L777-L784) 先在本机执行 `flutter build web` 并复制到 `cmd/web/dist`，随后 [build.yml:L785-L802](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/.github/workflows/build.yml#L785-L802) 用 `docker/build-push-action` 以 QEMU/Buildx 构建 `linux/386`、`linux/amd64`、`linux/arm64`、`linux/arm/v7` 四个架构，打上 `liwei2633/gopeed:latest` 与版本号标签推送——这也再次解释了为什么 Dockerfile 必须 `CGO_ENABLED=0`：四个架构里多数没有现成的 C 交叉工具链。
509	
510	#### 4.3.4 代码实践
511	
512	**实践目标**：用 Docker 跑起 Web 版 Gopeed，并通过 API 验证「容器内构建注入」确实生效。
513	
514	**操作步骤**：
515	
516	1. **方式 A（推荐，无需 Flutter）**：直接使用官方镜像，在仓库根目录执行：
517	
518	   ```bash
519	   docker compose up -d
520	   docker compose logs -f gopeed   # 看到 banner 与 Server start success 即就绪
521	   ```
522	
523	2. 验证服务与注入信息：
524	
525	   ```bash
526	   curl http://127.0.0.1:9999/api/v1/info
527	   ```
528	
529	3. 浏览器访问 `http://localhost:9999`，确认出现 Gopeed Web UI，可新建一个 HTTP 下载任务。
530	
531	4. **方式 B（完整本地构建，需要 Flutter 3.41+）**：模拟 CI 流程后本地构建镜像：
532	
533	   ```bash
534	   cd ui/flutter && flutter build web && cd ../../
535	   rm -rf cmd/web/dist && cp -r ui/flutter/build/web cmd/web/dist
536	   docker build -t gopeed:lab .
537	   docker run -d -p 9998:9999 -v ~/gopeed-lab:/app/Downloads gopeed:lab
538	   curl http://127.0.0.1:9998/api/v1/info
539	   ```
540	
541	5. （可选）开启登录认证：编辑 `docker-compose.yml`，取消 `command: -u Username -p Password` 的注释（换成自己的账号密码），`docker compose up -d` 重建后浏览器访问将要求登录。
542	
543	**需要观察的现象**：
544	
545	- 第 2 步返回的 JSON 中 `inDocker: true`、`version` 为具体版本号（非 `dev`）——与 4.2.4 中本地构建的 `dev` / `false` 形成对照。
546	- 第 3 步 Web UI 正常可用；创建任务后文件出现在宿主机 `~/gopeed/Downloads`（compose 挂载）。
547	- 第 4 步（若执行）本地构建的镜像同样 `inDocker: true`（Dockerfile 写死注入）。
548	- 第 5 步开启认证后，未登录的浏览器访问会跳转登录页。
549	
550	**预期结果**：`/api/v1/info` 返回类似 `{"version":"x.y.z", ..., "inDocker":true, "os":"linux", "arch":"..."}` 的结果。若在 Apple Silicon 或 ARM 机器上，`arch` 会是 `arm64`（对应多架构镜像自动选择的架构）。具体 JSON 字段顺序与版本号**待本地验证**。
551	
552	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
553	
554	**练习 1**：容器里的 `PUID=1000 PGID=1000` 是如何变成文件属主的？
555	
556	**答案**：[entrypoint.sh:L1-L6](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/entrypoint.sh#L1-L6) 先 `chown -R ${PUID}:${PGID} /app` 把容器内目录改为指定属主，再用 `su-exec ${PUID}:${PGID}` 让服务进程以该用户身份运行，于是下载产生的新文件属主即为 `PUID`，与宿主机用户对齐。
557	
558	**练习 2**：为什么 compose 要把宿主机目录挂载到容器的 `/app/Downloads` 而不是别的路径？
559	
560	**答案**：容器形态下 Dockerfile 注入了 `InDocker=true`，[cmd/server.go:L42-L44](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/server.go#L42-L44) 由此把默认下载目录设为「存储目录旁的 Downloads」，即 `/app/Downloads`。挂载点必须与这个默认值一致，文件才会落到宿主机。
561	
562	**练习 3**：如果直接对「没有执行过 `flutter build web` 的仓库」执行 `docker build`，会在哪一步失败？
563	
564	**答案**：在阶段一的 `go build` 失败。因为 `COPY . .` 不会带来不存在的 `cmd/web/dist`，而 [cmd/web/main.go:L17-L18](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/web/main.go#L17-L18) 的 `//go:embed dist/*` 匹配不到文件会直接编译报错。所以纯 Go 环境想快速体验请用方式 A（官方镜像），完整本地构建必须先产出前端资源。
565	
566	## 5. 综合实践
567	
568	把本讲三个模块串起来，完成一次「从源码到三端运行」的完整走查，并把每一步用到的构建参数记录成表：
569	
570	1. **CLI 路线**：`go build -o bin/gopeed ./cmd/gopeed`，用 4.1.4 的本地 HTTP 服务完成一次下载。
571	2. **Web 路线**：按 4.2.4 的五步实验走完（含两次预期失败的构建），最后用 `-ldflags "-X ...=自定义版本"` 产出二进制，`curl /api/v1/info` 验证。
572	3. **Docker 路线**：按 4.3.4 方式 A 启动官方镜像，再次 `curl /api/v1/info` 对比。
573	
574	最终交付一张「构建参数对照表」，参考格式：
575	
576	| 路线 | 命令关键参数 | CGO | 产物 | `version` | `inDocker` |
577	| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
578	| CLI | （无） | 默认开启 | `bin/gopeed` | dev | false |
579	| Web 本地 | `-tags web`（可选加 `-ldflags -X`） | 默认开启 | 单二进制 | dev 或注入值 | false |
580	| Docker | `-tags nosqlite,web` + `CGO_ENABLED=0` + 两个 `-X` | 关闭 | 镜像内 `/app/gopeed` | 镜像版本 | true |
581	
582	表中 CLI/Web 两行的 `inDocker` 值与 CGO 状态**待本地验证**（`inDocker` 为 false 的原因：未注入时是空字符串，`"dev"` 兜底逻辑只作用于 `Version`，`InDocker == "true"` 的判断为假）。
583	
584	## 6. 本讲小结
585	
586	- Gopeed 是单一 Go module，通过「不同入口包 + 不同构建参数」产出五种形态：`cmd/gopeed`（CLI）、`cmd/api`（开发用最小服务）、`cmd/web`（嵌入 UI 的 Web 服务端）、`bind/desktop`（c-shared 动态库）、`bind/mobile`（gomobile 绑定）。
587	- `-tags web` 是仓库内唯一的 `web` 标签门禁，同时 `go:embed dist/*` 要求先构建 Flutter Web 并复制到 `cmd/web/dist`，二者共同决定了 Web 服务端的构建顺序。
588	- `-tags nosqlite` 不对应本仓库任何文件，它作用于依赖（`go.mod` 中 SQLite 包全为 indirect），配合 `CGO_ENABLED=0` 实现纯 Go 多架构交叉编译；仓库自己的 `cgo` 开关用例是 WebView 提供者的条件编译。
589	- `-ldflags "-X ..."` 在链接期把 `Version` / `InDocker` 注入 [pkg/base/info.go](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/pkg/base/info.go)，运行时经 `/api/v1/info` 暴露；`InDocker` 还会改变默认下载目录的业务分支（`/app/Downloads` vs `~/Downloads`）。
590	- Docker 部署是两阶段构建 + `entrypoint.sh` 权限映射（PUID/PGID/UMASK + su-exec）的组合；官方镜像 `liwei2633/gopeed` 覆盖 linux/386、amd64、arm64、arm/v7 四个架构。
591	- `cmd/web` 的配置加载优先级是「config.json → `GOPEED_` 前缀环境变量 → 命令行参数覆盖」。
592	
593	## 7. 下一步学习建议
594	
595	现在你已经能把项目跑起来，下一步（u1-l3「仓库地图：目录结构与模块职责」）会带你把 `cmd`、`bind`、`pkg`、`internal`、`ui/flutter` 各目录的职责逐一讲清，建立快速定位源码的索引能力。在此之前，建议你顺手做两件事：
596	
597	1. 在本地仓库执行 `ls cmd/`，对照本讲的入口包清单，看看还有哪些入口（`host`、`updater`、`extmock`）是我们没讲到的，先猜猜它们的用途。
598	2. 打开 [go.mod](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/go.mod) 通读一遍 require 列表，标记你认识的第三方库（如 `gorilla/mux`、`anacrolix/torrent`、`dop251/goja`、`go.etcd.io/bbolt`），它们分别是后续 HTTP、BT、扩展系统、存储等单元的伏笔。

# 把它跑起来：环境准备与各端构建运行

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u1-l1）我们建立了「一个 Go 核心 + 多种外壳」的架构认知。本讲解决一个非常实际的问题：**亲手把 Gopeed 构建出来并跑起来**。

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 用 `go install` / `go build` 两种方式构建 Gopeed 的 CLI（命令行下载器），并用它完成一次真实下载。
2. 说清构建命令矩阵：CLI、纯 API 服务、Web 服务端、桌面动态库、移动端绑定分别对应哪个入口包、用什么命令、带哪些参数。
3. 理解 `-tags nosqlite,web`、`-buildmode=c-shared`、`-ldflags "-X ..."` 这些构建参数的确切含义，并能在源码中找到它们作用的证据。
4. 用 `docker compose` 启动 Web 版 Gopeed，并通过 `/api/v1/info` 接口验证容器内的运行状态。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲会用到一些 Go 工具链与容器的基础概念，先用通俗语言过一遍：

| 概念 | 通俗解释 |
| --- | --- |
| 编译型语言 | Go 源码需要先「编译」成机器码（二进制文件）才能运行，不像 Python 那样边读边执行。产物是一个可直接执行的文件。 |
| 交叉编译 | 在一台机器上编译出「给另一种操作系统/CPU 架构用」的二进制。Go 对此支持极好，例如在 Mac 上编译 Linux amd64 的服务器程序。 |
| CGO | Go 调用 C 代码的机制。开启 CGO 后编译产物依赖本地 C 工具链（gcc/clang），交叉编译会变难；设置 `CGO_ENABLED=0` 则强制纯 Go 编译。 |
| build tags（构建标签） | 写在 Go 文件第一行的条件编译指令，如 `//go:build web`。`go build -tags web` 时该文件参与编译，否则被排除。同一目录下可以有「带标签」和「不带标签」的多套实现。 |
| `-ldflags "-X ..."` | 链接期变量注入。在编译时把一个字符串「塞进」某个包的全局变量，最典型的用途是注入版本号，避免手工改源码。 |
| `-buildmode=c-shared` | 把 Go 代码编译成 C 风格的动态库（Windows 的 `.dll`、macOS 的 `.dylib`、Linux 的 `.so`），供其他语言（如 Dart/Flutter）通过 FFI 调用。 |
| gomobile | Go 官方提供的工具，把 Go 包编译成 Android 的 `.aar` 和 iOS 的 framework，供移动端 App 嵌入。 |
| `go:embed` | Go 1.16+ 的指令，把静态文件（如编译好的前端页面）**打包进二进制内部**，部署时只需要分发一个可执行文件。 |
| 多阶段 Docker 构建 | Dockerfile 里先在一个「胖」阶段（带完整 Go 工具链）编译，再只把产物复制进一个「瘦」阶段（如 alpine），最终镜像很小。 |
| PUID / PGID / umask | Linux 权限三件套。容器内默认以 root 运行，通过这两个用户 ID 和文件权限掩码，让下载的文件归属宿主机指定的用户。 |

如果某些概念暂时体会不深，没关系，第 4 节会结合 Gopeed 的真实源码逐一对照。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 构建命令矩阵：一个核心，多种产物

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

Gopeed 是单一 Go module（`github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed`），但通过**不同的入口包 + 不同的构建参数**，能产出形态完全不同的产物。这就是上一讲「一个核心、多种外壳」在构建层面的体现。

理解本模块的关键不是背命令，而是抓住一张「入口包 → 产物」的映射表：

| 产物 | 入口包 | 核心命令 | 需要的构建标签 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CLI 命令行下载器 | `cmd/gopeed` | `go build` / `go install` | 无 |
| 纯 API 服务（本地开发） | `cmd/api` | `go build ./cmd/api` | 无 |
| Web 服务端（含嵌入 UI） | `cmd/web` | `flutter build web` 后 `go build -tags nosqlite,web` | `web`（以及 `nosqlite`） |
| 桌面动态库 | `bind/desktop` | `go build -buildmode=c-shared` | `nosqlite` |
| Android / iOS 绑定 | `bind/mobile` | `gomobile bind` | `nosqlite` |

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

以最常用的三条路径为例，流程如下：

```text
路径 A：CLI
  go install / go build
    └─ cmd/gopeed（无构建约束）
         └─ download.Boot() 链式 API 直连核心

路径 B：Web 服务端
  flutter build web                       # 先产出静态页面
    └─ cp 到 cmd/web/dist/                # 供 go:embed 嵌入
         └─ go build -tags nosqlite,web ./cmd/web
              └─ cmd.Start(cfg)           # 共享启动逻辑（cmd/server.go）

路径 C：桌面
  go build -tags nosqlite -buildmode=c-shared ./bind/desktop
    └─ 生成 libgopeed.dll / .dylib / .so
         └─ flutter build windows / macos / linux 把动态库打进 App
```

注意路径 B 的依赖顺序：**必须先有 `cmd/web/dist` 目录，Go 编译才能通过**（原因见 4.2 模块），这也是为什么直接 `docker build` 一个不含 dist 的仓库会失败，详见 4.3。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：本地从源码构建 CLI，并完成一次真实下载（不依赖外网也可以做）。

**操作步骤**：

1. 在仓库根目录执行（无需任何标签）：

   ```bash
   go build -o bin/gopeed ./cmd/gopeed
   ```

2. 制造一个本地下载源（避免依赖公网直链的有效性）：

   ```bash
   mkdir -p /tmp/gopeed-lab && cd /tmp/gopeed-lab
   dd if=/dev/urandom of=demo.bin bs=1M count=8   # 生成 8MB 测试文件
   python3 -m http.server 8000
   ```

3. 另开一个终端，用刚构建的 CLI 下载：

   ```bash
   ./bin/gopeed -D /tmp/gopeed-dl http://127.0.0.1:8000/demo.bin
   ```

4. 再试一次多连接与单连接的差别：

   ```bash
   ./bin/gopeed -C 1 -D /tmp/gopeed-dl http://127.0.0.1:8000/demo.bin
   ./bin/gopeed -C 8 -D /tmp/gopeed-dl http://127.0.0.1:8000/demo.bin
   ```

**需要观察的现象**：

- 终端出现 `■□□□...` 格式的进度条，实时刷新（由 [cmd/gopeed/main.go:L82-L113](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/gopeed/main.go#L82-L113) 的 `printProgress` 用 `\r` 回车覆写实现）。
- 下载结束打印 `complete` 与 `saving path: /tmp/gopeed-dl`。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `go install github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/cmd/gopeed@latest` 不需要任何 `-tags`，而构建 `cmd/web` 必须加 `-tags web`？

**答案**：`cmd/gopeed` 目录下的 Go 文件没有任何 `//go:build` 约束，默认全部参与编译；`cmd/web/main.go` 第一行是 `//go:build web`，不加标签时该包的所有 Go 文件都被构建系统排除，`go build ./cmd/web` 会直接报错（详见 4.2.4 实践第 1 步）。

**练习 2**：`cmd/api` 和 `cmd/web` 都能启动 REST 服务，它们的核心差异是什么？

**答案**：`cmd/api` 的 `StartConfig` 是硬编码的（固定 `127.0.0.1:9999`、Bolt 存储），注释标明只用于本地开发；`cmd/web` 把监听地址、鉴权、存储目录、白名单等全部参数化（flags / config.json / 环境变量三层加载），并用 `go:embed` 把 Flutter Web 静态资源嵌进二进制，是可部署的生产形态。

**练习 3**：如果你想给 macOS 桌面版构建动态库，应该执行什么命令？产物需要放到哪里？

**答案**：参考 [README.md:L137](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/README.md#L137)：`go build -tags nosqlite -ldflags="-w -s" -buildmode=c-shared -o ui/flutter/macos/Frameworks/libgopeed.dylib github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/bind/desktop`，随后在 `ui/flutter` 目录执行 `flutter build macos`。产物路径是 Flutter 工程的约定位置，不能随意放。

### 4.2 build tags 与构建期注入：`nosqlite`、`web` 与 `-ldflags -X`

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

本模块解决三个「编译期开关」问题：

1. **`web` 标签**：Gopeed 自己源码里的开关，控制 `cmd/web` 这个入口是否存在。它的存在让「不带 UI 的仓库」也能编译出所有其他产物，同时避免 `go vet ./...`、IDE 对一个缺少 `dist` 目录的包反复报错。
2. **`nosqlite` 标签**：**不在 Gopeed 自己的源码里**（我们在仓库内全局搜索 `nosqlite`，只命中 README、Dockerfile、CI 的构建命令，没有任何 `//go:build nosqlite`）。它是传给**依赖库**的开关，作用与 SQLite 相关代码的裁剪有关，目的是让 `CGO_ENABLED=0` 的纯 Go 交叉编译可行。
3. **`-ldflags "-X ..."`**：编译期把版本号、是否在 Docker 内这两个信息注入 [pkg/base/info.go](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/pkg/base/info.go) 的全局变量，运行时通过 `/api/v1/info` 接口暴露。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

构建标签的判定流程（以 `cmd/web` 为例）：

```text
go build ./cmd/web                go build -tags web ./cmd/web
        │                                   │
        ▼                                   ▼
读取 main.go 的 //go:build web          标签集合 = {web}
        │                                   │
   标签集合 = {} ──► 条件不满足 ──► 文件被排除
   结果：包内没有任何 Go 文件
   报错：build constraints exclude all Go files
                                        │
                                        ▼
                              main.go 参与编译
                              继续处理 //go:embed dist/*
                              要求 dist 目录存在且有匹配文件
```

`-ldflags -X` 的注入流程：

```text
go build -ldflags "-X pkg/path.Variable=value"
        │
        ▼
链接阶段把字符串 value 写入目标变量的初始值
        │
        ▼
运行时 pkg/base.Version / pkg/base.InDocker 即为注入值
        │
        ▼
GET /api/v1/info 返回 {version, inDocker, os, arch, ...}
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**① `web` 标签的门禁：`cmd/web/main.go` 头两行**

[cmd/web/main.go:L1-L2](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/web/main.go#L1-L2) 是整个仓库里唯一一处 `//go:build web`：

```go
//go:build web
// +build web
```

（第二行 `// +build` 是 Go 1.17 之前的旧语法，保留它可以在老工具链上同样生效。）

**② `go:embed` 要求 dist 必须先存在**

[cmd/web/main.go:L17-L24](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/web/main.go#L17-L24) 把 Flutter Web 构建产物嵌入二进制：

```go
//go:embed dist/*
var dist embed.FS

func main() {
	sub, err := fs.Sub(dist, "dist")
```

`embed.FS` 的模式 `dist/*` 若匹配不到任何文件，编译直接失败。所以 README 的 Web 构建流程（[README.md:L182-L189](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/README.md#L182-L189)）是三步走：`flutter build web` → `rm -rf cmd/web/dist && cp -r ui/flutter/build/web cmd/web/dist` → `go build -tags nosqlite,web ...`。

**③ 注入目标：`pkg/base/info.go`**

[pkg/base/info.go:L3-L11](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/pkg/base/info.go#L3-L11) 定义了两个「编译期留空、构建时填充」的变量，注释里就写着注入示例：

```go
// Version is the build version, set at build time, using `go build -ldflags "-X github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/pkg/base.Version=1.0.0"`.
var Version string
var InDocker string

func init() {
	if Version == "" {
		Version = "dev"
	}
}
```

不做注入时 `Version` 为空字符串，`init()` 会兜底成 `"dev"`——这就是为什么源码直接 `go build` 出来的程序版本号显示 `dev`。

**④ 观察点：`/api/v1/info`**

[pkg/rest/api.go:L13-L22](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/pkg/rest/api.go#L13-L22) 把这两个变量连同运行时信息一起返回：

```go
func Info(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	info := map[string]any{
		"version":  base.Version,
		"runtime":  runtime.Version(),
		"os":       runtime.GOOS,
		"arch":     runtime.GOARCH,
		"inDocker": base.InDocker == "true",
	}
```

路由挂载在 `/api/v1/info`（可在 [pkg/rest/invoke_test.go:L33](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/pkg/rest/invoke_test.go#L33) 的测试中看到这个路径）。它是我们验证「注入是否生效」的最直接手段。

**⑤ `nosqlite` 的证据链**

事实一：仓库内没有任何 `.go` 文件带 `nosqlite` 构建约束——构建命令（README/Dockerfile/CI）里的 `-tags nosqlite` 传给了依赖图。

事实二：[go.mod:L111-L112](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/go.mod#L111-L112) 与 [go.mod:L172-L173](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/go.mod#L172-L173) 中，所有 SQLite 相关包（`go-llsqlite/adapter`、`go-llsqlite/crawshaw`、`modernc.org/sqlite`、`zombiezen.com/go/sqlite`）**全部是 indirect（间接）依赖**，它们由 BT 协议依赖的 `anacrolix/torrent`（[go.mod:L8](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/go.mod#L8)）引入，用于 BT 的 piece 完成状态存储。

事实三：Dockerfile 与 CI 在 `CGO_ENABLED=0` 交叉编译时总是带上 `nosqlite`（[.github/workflows/build.yml:L666-L686](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/.github/workflows/build.yml#L666-L686) 中 Web 服务器对 windows/darwin/linux × 386/amd64/arm64 九个组合的循环里同时设置了 `export CGO_ENABLED=0` 与 `-tags nosqlite,web`）。

结论：`nosqlite` 用于在依赖层面裁掉 SQLite（含 CGO 实现）相关代码路径，使纯 Go 交叉编译可行。该标签在**依赖库源码内部**具体排除了哪些文件，本仓库无法直接看到，**待本地验证**（可在模块缓存中搜索 `//go:build nosqlite`，或对比加/不加标签时 `go list -deps ./cmd/web` 的差异）。

**⑥ 对照组：仓库自己的 `cgo` 标签用例**

并非所有编译开关都藏在依赖里。[internal/webview/goprovider/provider.go:L1-L2](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/internal/webview/goprovider/provider.go#L1-L2) 用 `//go:build cgo` 控制「原生 WebView 提供者」是否参与编译——`CGO_ENABLED=0` 时 Go 会自动禁用 `cgo` 标签，这个依赖 `webview_go`（C 绑定）的文件就被整体排除。这解释了为什么服务器/容器形态（无 GUI）可以完全纯 Go 编译，而桌面形态必须装 C 工具链（README 桌面构建一节强调的 cgo 要求）。

**练习 1**：在仓库里执行 `git grep "go:build nosqlite"` 没有任何结果，这说明什么？

**答案**：说明 `nosqlite` 标签不控制本仓库的任何文件，它通过 `-tags` 传递给依赖库生效。结合 `go.mod` 中 SQLite 相关包全部是 indirect、以及 CI 在 `CGO_ENABLED=0` 交叉编译时总是携带该标签这两个事实，可推断其用途是裁掉依赖中的 SQLite/CGO 代码路径以支持纯 Go 编译（依赖内部具体机制待确认）。

**练习 2**：不做任何 `-ldflags` 注入直接构建的二进制，`/api/v1/info` 里 `version` 会是什么？为什么？

### 4.3 Docker 部署入口：多阶段镜像与容器启动

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

对使用者来说，Docker 是体验 Gopeed Web 版门槛最低的方式：一条 `docker compose up` 就能得到带完整 Web UI 的下载服务。对源码学习者来说，Dockerfile 是一份「官方构建命令的浓缩版」——它把 4.1、4.2 两个模块的知识点全部固化在一行 `go build` 里。

需要理解的容器背景知识：

- **多阶段构建**：第一阶段用 `golang:1.25.4-alpine` 镜像编译，第二阶段只把产物复制进干净的 `alpine:3.23`，最终镜像不含 Go 工具链。
- **su-exec**：alpine 下的轻量「以指定用户执行命令」工具（sudo 的极简替代），配合 `PUID/PGID` 实现权限映射。
- **数据卷**：容器是临时的，任务数据库（`/app/storage`）与下载目录（`/app/Downloads`）需要挂载到宿主机才能持久化。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

官方镜像（`liwei2633/gopeed`）从 CI 到运行的完整链路：

```text
CI（build-docker 任务，build.yml）
  flutter build web --no-web-resources-cdn
    └─ rm -rf cmd/web/dist && cp -r ui/flutter/build/web cmd/web/dist
         └─ docker buildx 多架构构建（linux/386, amd64, arm64, arm/v7）
              └─ 推送 liwei2633/gopeed:latest 与 :v版本号

Dockerfile（两阶段）
  阶段1 golang:1.25.4-alpine
    CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -tags nosqlite,web
      -ldflags "-s -w -X base.Version=$VERSION -X base.InDocker=true"
    → dist/gopeed（单个自包含二进制，UI 已嵌入）
  阶段2 alpine:3.23
    复制二进制 + entrypoint.sh，安装 su-exec
    VOLUME /app/storage，EXPOSE 9999

运行时（entrypoint.sh）
  chown -R PUID:PGID /app → umask → su-exec 降权 exec ./gopeed "$@"
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**① Dockerfile 的编译阶段：一行命令浓缩全部构建知识**

[Dockerfile:L6-L9](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/Dockerfile#L6-L9)：

```dockerfile
ARG VERSION=dev
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -tags nosqlite,web \
      -ldflags="-s -w -X github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/pkg/base.Version=$VERSION -X github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/pkg/base.InDocker=true" \
      -o dist/gopeed github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/cmd/web
```

逐项拆解：`CGO_ENABLED=0`（纯 Go，配合 alpine 与多架构交叉编译）、`-tags nosqlite,web`（4.2 讲过的两个标签）、`-X` 注入 `Version` 与 `InDocker` 两个变量。注意 `InDocker` 被写死为 `true`——因为程序运行在容器里，这个信息必须构建期告知。

**② 运行阶段：权限与端口约定**

[Dockerfile:L11-L23](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/Dockerfile#L11-L23) 声明了 `VOLUME /app/storage`（任务数据库）、`ENV PUID=0 PGID=0 UMASK=022`、`EXPOSE 9999` 与入口脚本。配合 [entrypoint.sh:L1-L6](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/entrypoint.sh#L1-L6)：

```sh
chown -R ${PUID}:${PGID} /app
umask ${UMASK}
exec su-exec ${PUID}:${PGID} ./gopeed "$@"
```

容器启动时先把 `/app` 整体归属到指定用户/组，再设置新建文件的默认权限掩码，最后降权执行下载服务。`"$@"` 会把 `docker run` 追加的参数透传给 `gopeed` 二进制（这就是 compose 里 `command: -u Username -p Password` 生效的原因）。

**③ docker-compose.yml：一键启动模板**

[docker-compose.yml:L1-L15](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/docker-compose.yml#L1-L15) 完整内容只有 15 行：映射 `9999:9999` 端口、设置 `PUID/PGID/UMASK`、把宿主机 `~/gopeed/Downloads` 挂到容器 `/app/Downloads`（storage 卷默认注释掉，按需打开），`restart: unless-stopped` 保证自愈，最后一行被注释的 `command:` 是开启 Web 登录认证的示例。

**④ `InDocker` 在运行时的分支意义**

[cmd/server.go:L39-L54](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/server.go#L39-L54) 首次启动时决定默认下载目录：

```go
// Set default download dir, in docker, it will be ${exe}/Downloads, else it will be ${user}/Downloads
if downloadDir == "" {
    if base.InDocker == "true" {
        downloadDir = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(cfg.StorageDir), "Downloads")
    } else {
        ...
        downloadDir = filepath.Join(userDir, "Downloads")
    }
```

容器内取「存储目录旁边的 Downloads」（即 `/app/Downloads`，与 compose 挂载点精确对应）；裸机则取用户主目录的 Downloads。这就是构建期注入的 `InDocker` 影响运行行为的直接证据——构建参数不只是「元数据」，它能改变业务分支。

**⑤ Web 服务的三层配置加载**

`cmd/web` 的参数有明确优先级。[cmd/web/flags.go:L31-L42](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/web/flags.go#L31-L42)：

```go
cliConfig := loadCliArgs()
loadConfigFile(cfg, *cliConfig.configPath)
loadEnvVars(cfg)
// override with non-default command line arguments
overrideWithCliArgs(cfg, cliConfig)
```

即：**配置文件（默认 `./config.json`）→ 环境变量 → 命令行参数覆盖**。命令行旗标定义在 [cmd/web/flags.go:L45-L64](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/web/flags.go#L45-L64)：`-A/-address`、`-P/-port`（默认 9999）、`-u/-username`、`-p/-password`（注释明确说明：不设密码则不启用 Web 认证）、`-T/-api-token`、`-mcp-enable`、`-d/-storage-dir`、`-white-download-dirs` 等。环境变量通过反射按 `GOPEED_` 前缀 + json 标签大写映射（[cmd/web/flags.go:L154-L176](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/web/flags.go#L154-L176)），例如 `GOPEED_PORT=9999`。

**⑥ CI 如何产出官方镜像**

[.github/workflows/build.yml:L777-L784](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/.github/workflows/build.yml#L777-L784) 先在本机执行 `flutter build web` 并复制到 `cmd/web/dist`，随后 [build.yml:L785-L802](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/.github/workflows/build.yml#L785-L802) 用 `docker/build-push-action` 以 QEMU/Buildx 构建 `linux/386`、`linux/amd64`、`linux/arm64`、`linux/arm/v7` 四个架构，打上 `liwei2633/gopeed:latest` 与版本号标签推送——这也再次解释了为什么 Dockerfile 必须 `CGO_ENABLED=0`：四个架构里多数没有现成的 C 交叉工具链。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：容器里的 `PUID=1000 PGID=1000` 是如何变成文件属主的？

**答案**：[entrypoint.sh:L1-L6](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/entrypoint.sh#L1-L6) 先 `chown -R ${PUID}:${PGID} /app` 把容器内目录改为指定属主，再用 `su-exec ${PUID}:${PGID}` 让服务进程以该用户身份运行，于是下载产生的新文件属主即为 `PUID`，与宿主机用户对齐。

**练习 2**：为什么 compose 要把宿主机目录挂载到容器的 `/app/Downloads` 而不是别的路径？

**答案**：容器形态下 Dockerfile 注入了 `InDocker=true`，[cmd/server.go:L42-L44](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/server.go#L42-L44) 由此把默认下载目录设为「存储目录旁的 Downloads」，即 `/app/Downloads`。挂载点必须与这个默认值一致，文件才会落到宿主机。

**练习 3**：如果直接对「没有执行过 `flutter build web` 的仓库」执行 `docker build`，会在哪一步失败？

**答案**：在阶段一的 `go build` 失败。因为 `COPY . .` 不会带来不存在的 `cmd/web/dist`，而 [cmd/web/main.go:L17-L18](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/fc0a1e0ef97ff5ec7f2dc875ff28925fe06b28ed/cmd/web/main.go#L17-L18) 的 `//go:embed dist/*` 匹配不到文件会直接编译报错。所以纯 Go 环境想快速体验请用方式 A（官方镜像），完整本地构建必须先产出前端资源。

## 6. 本讲小结

- Gopeed 是单一 Go module，通过「不同入口包 + 不同构建参数」产出五种形态：`cmd/gopeed`（CLI）、`cmd/api`（开发用最小服务）、`cmd/web`（嵌入 UI 的 Web 服务端）、`bind/desktop`（c-shared 动态库）、`bind/mobile`（gomobile 绑定）。
- `-tags web` 是仓库内唯一的 `web` 标签门禁，同时 `go:embed dist/*` 要求先构建 Flutter Web 并复制到 `cmd/web/dist`，二者共同决定了 Web 服务端的构建顺序。
- `-tags nosqlite` 不对应本仓库任何文件，它作用于依赖（`go.mod` 中 SQLite 包全为 indirect），配合 `CGO_ENABLED=0` 实现纯 Go 多架构交叉编译；仓库自己的 `cgo` 开关用例是 WebView 提供者的条件编译。

Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }

  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.
